Q: coordinate proximity for likert scale analysis (php) A:

After some thinking, I came up with this.

Every question Q can produce an attractor and/or a repeller at its position:

  • If Q has any positive responses, then an attractor is produced with strength equal to the sum of positive scales

  • If Q has any negative responses, then a repeller is produced with strength equal to the sum of negative scales

If all responses are neutral, Q has no effect.

After processing all questions, we obtain Na attractors and Nr repellers.

If Na = 0, the final point is undefined.

If Na > 0:

  • Compute the average A of the attractors (usual weighted average)

  • For every repeller R, compute a repelling effect on A (the exact formula needs to be defined, based on the positions of A and R and the relative strengths)

  • Add all the effects to A to get the coordinates of the final point

Note: if any repeller R is at the same position as A, the final point is undefined.
